reason: I already have a supplement I reorder when it runs out and I'm not looking to switch. Magnesium by itself for $30 a month feels like a lot when I'm already spending on my usual one.
objection: Why one form of magnesium when others have 8 forms in one capsule? And it's made in China, I'd have to take their word on the lab thing.
would_change_my_mind: A much lower price, like under $20 a box, or seeing a lot of real moms I follow on TikTok say it actually helped them sleep.
